newsitem.title: USA: United Airlines to revamp economy class meals.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines to revamp economy class meals.

text.p: United Airlines, a unit of UAL Corp, said Tuesday it will offer 17 new regional entrees in its main cabin as part of an enhanced catering service program starting May 5.

The carrier said Sheila Lukins, a culinary expert who has written several cookbooks, has worked closely with its executive chefs to devise meals that feature interesting, but familiar foods. These include BBQ roast beef, chicken pot pie and baked lasagna, United said.
UAL shares were up 5/8 Tuesday at 71-1/4.
